text.text_excerpt: While Hotel Le Marais in itself is not a luxury 5 star hotel, overall it earns 5 stars. From the first moment we arrived the staff were friendly, polite, and very helpful. Erica? checked us in quickly, was so vibrant and even offered to help us find entertainment for the evening. Each time we came back to the hotel we were greeted and even when we passed it on the street. The attached bar, Vive!, makes great drinks and there is a pool on the property which I enjoyed twice (in November). While lunch and dinner are not served on the property there are many restaurants less than a few minutes walk and delivery is very easy. The hotel is immaculate, everywhere from the lobby, to the hallways,...

Great Location! Great Staff (Afternoon & Evening staff were so helpful)! Clean & modern. Very trendy looking on the inside and super clean. Great bath products and we always had ample fresh towels. Bed was comfortable but a few of the pillows were huge and in the way (first world problems) For the location, relative quiet environment and price, this place can't be beat. *Although the hotel is designed to keep out the sound from outside (bourbon street & drunkards) it was not designed to be that quiet in the interior. Starting around 7am you could hear doors slamming and people shuffling around. If you are a light sleeper make sure to bring ear plugs. The bar here is pretty nice, the bar t...

We stayed here one night over Memorial Day weekend. Parking was $20 valet across the street and the front desk staff let us check in a little early because our room was ready. They were very nice and super friendly. The hotel lobby/bar area is small but clean and modern and opens to a little courtyard with seating and the small pool. It's a nice little oasis in the madness of the French Quarter. It's about half a block to Bourbon Street, but you don't hear anything once you're in the hotel. Our room was clean, with a comfortable bed, and nice towels.
